intro: The Eastern Strand is a stretch of southern coastline in Hillsbrad Foothills, lying to the southeast toward the border of the Arathi Highlands. Once peaceful shores, the beaches and shallows have been overrun by hostile Daggerspine naga establishing a coastal beachhead.

p: Running along the southeastern edge of Hillsbrad Foothills, the Eastern Strand complements the Western Strand across the bay. While the region is primarily known for human farming settlements and territorial clashes between Southshore and Tarren Mill, these sandy flats and tidelines are dominated entirely by the Daggerspine naga. Creeping out of the Great Sea, the serpent folk slither across the sandbars and dwell among the rocky outcrops, watching the mainland closely.
